title: The Action Song
text:
Head, shoulders, knees and toes is a fun song. We sing it with our hands. We touch each part of the body. The song is fast and happy.

Now we sing it again. Some children jump. Some children clap. Everybody laughs and smiles.

questions.text: What do we touch in the song?
How do the children probably feel?
Why is this song good for children?
options: It is fun and they can move

vocabulary.definition: to make music with your voice
to hit your hands together to make a sound

paragraph_translations: Cabeça, ombros, joelhos e pés é uma música divertida. Cantamos com as mãos. Tocamos em cada parte do corpo. A música é rápida e alegre.
Agora cantamos de novo. Algumas crianças pulam. Algumas crianças batem palmas. Todos riem e sorriem.
